title: Message containing both candidate and recruiter email addresses
description: Email header or text contains both candidate destination (sneha.student@example.com) and recruiter sender (talent.acquisition@tata-elxsi.example). System must separate semantic roles.
raw_text:
To: sneha.student@example.com
From: talent.acquisition@tata-elxsi.example
Date: 03 Oct 2026 10:15 IST
Subject: Offer of Employment - Embedded Systems Engineer
Dear Sneha, Tata Elxsi is pleased to offer you the role of Embedded Systems Engineer. CTC: INR 7.2 LPA.
Please confirm your acceptance by replying to this email.

organic_results.title: Tata Elxsi Official Careers
organic_results.snippet: Join Tata Elxsi design and technology team.

recruiter_assessment.summary: Recruiter corporate email verified against Tata Elxsi official domain. Candidate email accurately recognized as recipient.

rationale: Extracting the first email found often misidentifies the candidate's webmail address as the recruiter's address, incorrectly triggering a PUBLIC_EMAIL_DOMAIN_USED scam flag. Semantic role extraction is required.
